title: Ramayana: Part One rises again on third Sunday, nears Rs 1,000 crore net in India
dek: Trackers put the film's third-weekend takings at Rs 74-79 crore and its worldwide gross at Rs 1,630-1,694 crore. It was third on the global weekend chart.
author: Declaration Desk
body:
Ramayana: Part One collected an estimated Rs 33 to 36 crore net in India on Sunday, its 18th day in cinemas, taking it close to Rs 1,000 crore in domestic net takings, according to box-office trackers' estimates published on Monday. The film's makers have not released official figures since its opening day, and the trackers' numbers differ.

One tracker put the third weekend, from Friday to Sunday, at about Rs 73.77 crore across all languages: Rs 14.54 crore on Friday, Rs 26.26 crore on Saturday and Rs 32.97 crore on Sunday. Another tracker, cited in reports, estimated Rs 15.75 crore, Rs 27.65 crore and Rs 35.60 crore, or about Rs 79 crore. Both show Sunday's takings more than double Friday's.

## The running totals

Reports differ on the totals. The first tracker puts the India net collection at about Rs 894 crore and the worldwide gross at about Rs 1,629.59 crore, including about Rs 552.53 crore from overseas. The second puts India net at about Rs 942.75 crore and worldwide gross at about Rs 1,693.50 crore, with about Rs 567 crore overseas. On the higher count the film needs less than Rs 60 crore more to cross Rs 1,000 crore net in India; on the lower one it needs more than Rs 100 crore.

The Hindi version still accounts for about three-quarters of the takings. On Sunday it earned about Rs 24.62 crore, with the Malayalam, Kannada, Tamil and Telugu versions sharing the rest, the first tracker's figures show.

On the estimates, the film is now in the all-time top five Indian films by worldwide gross, though the trackers differ on its exact position.

## Third in the world

Ramayana: Part One was the third-highest-grossing film worldwide over the weekend of 20 to 22 November, with about $13.8 million, according to figures from the measurement company Comscore cited in reports. The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping led the chart with about $225 million. Comscore's cumulative figure for the film was about $182.9 million across 64 territories.

Among other films released in India last week, the Hindi film Kaali Kheti made about Rs 66 lakh over its opening weekend and Godzilla Minus Zero about Rs 3.09 crore, according to the first tracker.

## Background

Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the film is the first of two parts and is produced by Namit Malhotra's Prime Focus Studios with Yash's Monster Mind Creations. It opened on 5 November, before Diwali. The makers said it collected Rs 155 crore gross worldwide on its first day, which they called the biggest pre-Diwali opening in Indian cinema. Its second weekend, an estimated Rs 196 crore net, was bigger than its first.

## What happens next

The film opens in Argentina, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, Czechia and Central America on 26 November, according to reports. Its fourth weekend will show whether it can hold up against new releases. Trackers' estimates are often revised, and an official update from the makers would be the first since the opening day.
